meta.note: Designed for students starting from absolute zero. Every subject covered from scratch. No prior preparation assumed. Minimum 6 hrs/day weekdays, 8+ hrs weekends. GATE CS has 11 subjects — time is tight, consistency is everything.

weekday.block: Deep study – new concepts from scratch (lecture + notes)
PYQ practice + DPP on today's topic

weekend.block: Mock test or timed mixed problem set

rules: Start every topic from absolute basics – never skip fundamentals
No passive lecture watching – pause after every concept and solve problems
PYQs immediately after each topic, not at the end of the week
Error log: write every wrong answer with mistake type and correct concept
Sunday evening: plan the full coming week day by day
GateOverflow is the primary PYQ discussion platform for GATE CS
Mock tests every Sunday from Week 10 onwards
General Aptitude: 30 min every Saturday throughout the plan

phases.title: Engineering Mathematics + Digital Logic + Programming & Data Structures
phases.note: Math and DS are the foundation. Every other subject uses these concepts. Start here, build strong.

daily_targets.Mon: Matrices: types, operations, determinant, rank, row reduction – lecture from scratch + 10 PYQs
daily_targets.Tue: System of linear equations: consistency (Rouche-Capelli), solutions – lecture + DPP
daily_targets.Wed: Eigenvalues and eigenvectors, diagonalization – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: Limits, continuity, differentiability (single variable) – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Fri: Partial derivatives, chain rule, maxima/minima (multivariable) – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Sat: Integration (definite, improper) + LA + Calculus PYQ set (timed, 45 min) + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: LA + Calculus full revision + all week wrong answers re-attempt + next week planning

weekly_plan.subject: Engineering Mathematics – Probability + Discrete Math
topics: Probability axioms, conditional probability, Bayes theorem
Graph theory: types, connectivity, planarity, coloring

daily_targets.Mon: Probability axioms, conditional probability, Bayes theorem, total probability – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Tue: Random variables: PMF, CDF, Binomial, Poisson, Normal – expectation, variance – lecture + DPP
daily_targets.Wed: Set theory, relations (reflexive/symmetric/transitive/equivalence), functions – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: Propositional logic: connectives, truth tables, tautology, resolution – predicate logic, quantifiers – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Fri: Graph theory: types, degree, connectivity, Euler/Hamiltonian, planarity, coloring, trees – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Sat: Combinatorics (permutation, combination, pigeonhole) + recurrence relations + full Engg Math PYQ set (timed) + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: Mock mini-test: full Engineering Mathematics (60 min) + analysis + planning

weekly_plan.subject: Digital Logic
topics: Number systems: binary, octal, hexadecimal, conversions
Combinational circuits: MUX, DEMUX, encoder, decoder, adder, subtractor

daily_targets.Mon: Number systems: binary, octal, hex, conversions, 2's complement, IEEE 754 – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Tue: Boolean algebra: theorems, De Morgan, SOP/POS + K-map minimization (2/3/4/5 variable) – lecture + DPP
daily_targets.Wed: Combinational circuits: MUX, DEMUX, encoder, decoder, full adder, subtractor – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: Flip-flops: SR, JK, D, T – state tables, excitation tables – lecture + problems
daily_targets.Fri: Sequential circuits: synchronous/asynchronous counters, shift registers, sequence detectors – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Sat: Hazards, PLDs + full Digital Logic PYQ set (timed, all years) + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: Digital Logic full revision + mock mini-test: DL only + planning

weekly_plan.subject: Programming & Data Structures – C + Linear DS
topics: C: pointers, arrays, structs, dynamic memory

daily_targets.Mon: C: data types, pointers, pointer arithmetic, arrays, strings – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Tue: C: structs, unions, dynamic memory (malloc, calloc, free), scope – lecture + DPP
daily_targets.Wed: C: functions, recursion (factorial, fibonacci, tree recursion), parameter passing (value vs reference) – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: Arrays, stacks, queues (linear, circular), deque – implementations + PYQs
daily_targets.Fri: Linked lists: singly, doubly, circular – insert, delete, reverse – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Sat: Hashing: hash functions, chaining, open addressing (linear/quadratic probing) + C + Linear DS PYQ set (timed) + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: C + Linear DS full revision + mock mini-test + planning

daily_targets.Mon: Binary trees: inorder, preorder, postorder traversals, height, level order – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Tue: BST: insert, delete (all 3 cases), search, inorder successor – lecture + DPP
daily_targets.Wed: AVL trees: balance factor, LL/RR/LR/RL rotations, height – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: Heaps: min-heap, max-heap, heapify, heap sort, priority queue – lecture + problems
daily_targets.Fri: Graphs: adjacency matrix vs list, BFS (level order), DFS (recursive + stack) – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Sat: Topological sort, spanning trees + full DS PYQ set (last 10 years, timed) + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: Mock test 1: Engg Math + Digital Logic + full DS (90 min) + analysis

phases.phase_end_milestone: 100% Engg Math + Digital Logic + DS PYQs (last 10 years) attempted. Mock 1 score > 50%.

phases.title: Algorithms + TOC + Compiler Design + OS + DBMS
phases.note: Core CS theory subjects. Each starts from scratch. High weightage group — do not rush. 6 weeks for 5 subjects.

weekly_plan.subject: Algorithms
topics: Sorting: bubble, insertion, selection, merge, quick, heap, counting, radix
Graph algorithms: Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford, Floyd-Warshall, Prim, Kruskal

daily_targets.Mon: Asymptotic analysis (Big-O, Omega, Theta) + recurrence (Master theorem, substitution) – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Tue: Sorting: merge sort, quick sort (analysis, best/worst/avg), heap sort + counting/radix – lecture + DPP
daily_targets.Wed: Binary search + Divide and conquer (merge sort recurrence, binary search analysis) – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: Greedy: activity selection, fractional knapsack, Huffman coding, job scheduling – lecture + problems
daily_targets.Fri: DP: LCS, LIS, 0-1 knapsack, matrix chain multiplication, edit distance, coin change – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Sat: Graph algorithms (Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford, Floyd-Warshall, Prim, Kruskal, topological sort, SCC) + P/NP + full Algorithms PYQ set (timed) + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: Algorithms full revision + mock mini-test: Algorithms only + planning

daily_targets.Mon: DFA: design, state minimization + NFA, epsilon-NFA, NFA-to-DFA conversion – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Tue: Regular expressions: construction, RE-to-DFA, equivalence + closure properties of regular languages – lecture + DPP
daily_targets.Wed: Pumping lemma (regular) + CFG: derivations, ambiguity, parse trees, leftmost/rightmost derivation – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: CNF, GNF conversions + PDA (by final state and empty stack) + CFL pumping lemma + closure properties – lecture + problems
daily_targets.Fri: Turing machines: design, variants (multi-tape, non-deterministic) + decidability vs undecidability – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Sat: Halting problem, reduction, Rice's theorem, Post Correspondence Problem + full TOC PYQ set (last 10 years, timed) + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: Mock test 2: Engg Math + DL + DS + Algorithms + TOC (full 3-hr mock) + analysis

daily_targets.Mon: Phases of compiler + Lexical analysis: tokens, lexemes, patterns, LEX tool – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Tue: First set and Follow set computation (practice multiple grammars) – lecture + DPP
daily_targets.Wed: LL(1) parsing: conditions, table construction, parsing trace – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: LR(0), SLR(1) parsing: items, closure, goto, table construction – lecture + problems
daily_targets.Fri: CLR(1), LALR(1) parsing: differences, table construction – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Sat: Syntax-directed translation + 3-address code + code optimization (peephole, DAG) + symbol table + full Compiler Design PYQ set (timed) + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: Compiler Design full revision + mock mini-test: TOC + Compiler Design + planning

weekly_plan.subject: Operating Systems – Process Management + Memory
topics: CPU scheduling: FCFS, SJF, SRTF, Round Robin, Priority
Deadlock: conditions, prevention, avoidance, detection, recovery
Paging: page tables, TLB, multi-level paging
Page replacement: FIFO, LRU, Optimal, Belady's anomaly

daily_targets.Mon: Processes vs threads, PCB, process states + CPU scheduling: FCFS, SJF, SRTF, RR, Priority – Gantt chart PYQs – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Tue: Process synchronization: semaphores (counting + binary), mutex, monitors + critical section + Peterson's solution – lecture + DPP
daily_targets.Wed: Deadlock: 4 conditions, prevention, avoidance (Banker's algorithm), detection, recovery – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: Memory management: contiguous allocation, internal/external fragmentation + paging: page tables, TLB, address translation – lecture + problems
daily_targets.Fri: Multi-level paging + virtual memory, demand paging, page fault handling – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Sat: Page replacement algorithms (FIFO, LRU, Optimal, Belady's anomaly) + OS Process + Memory PYQ set (timed) + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: Mock test 3: + Compiler Design + OS (partial) added to mock scope (full 3 hr) + analysis

weekly_plan.subject: Operating Systems – File Systems + I/O + DBMS
topics: File systems: inode structure, directory, allocation methods (contiguous, linked, indexed)
Disk scheduling: FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, C-SCAN, LOOK

daily_targets.Mon: File systems: inode, directory structure, contiguous/linked/indexed allocation + disk scheduling (FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, C-SCAN) – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Tue: RAID levels + I/O subsystem + full OS PYQ set (last 10 years, timed) – all OS topics
daily_targets.Wed: ER model: entities, attributes, relationships, weak entities, ER-to-relational mapping + relational algebra: select, project, join, division – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: SQL: DDL, DML, joins (inner/outer/cross/self), subqueries, aggregation, GROUP BY, HAVING – lecture + DPP
daily_targets.Fri: Normalization: functional dependencies, 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF, decomposition (lossy/lossless), dependency preservation – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Sat: Transactions (ACID, serializability, conflict serializability, 2PL) + Indexing (B-tree, B+-tree) + full DBMS PYQ set (timed) + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: Mock test 4: all subjects covered so far (full 3 hr) + analysis

weekly_plan.subject: Computer Networks
topics: Data link layer: framing, error detection (CRC, Hamming), error correction
Network layer: IPv4 addressing, subnetting, CIDR, NAT
Routing algorithms: distance vector (RIP), link state (OSPF), BGP
Transport layer: TCP (3-way handshake, flow control, congestion control), UDP
Application layer: DNS, HTTP, FTP, SMTP, DHCP, SNMP

daily_targets.Mon: OSI + TCP/IP models (every layer function, protocols at each layer) + Physical layer (Nyquist, Shannon) – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Tue: Data link layer: framing, error detection (CRC, Hamming code), error correction + ARQ protocols (Stop-and-Wait, Go-Back-N, Selective Repeat) – lecture + DPP
daily_targets.Wed: MAC protocols: Pure ALOHA, Slotted ALOHA, CSMA/CD, CSMA/CA + Ethernet + MAC addresses – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: Network layer: IPv4 addressing, subnetting, CIDR, NAT + routing algorithms (RIP, OSPF, BGP) – lecture + problems
daily_targets.Fri: Transport layer: TCP (3-way handshake, 4-way teardown, sliding window, flow control, congestion control – slow start, AIMD) + UDP – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Sat: Application layer (DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, FTP, SMTP, DHCP) + full Computer Networks PYQ set (last 10 years, timed) + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: Mock test 5: full syllabus except CO&A + Aptitude (full 3 hr) + analysis

phases.phase_end_milestone: Algorithms + TOC + Compiler + OS + DBMS + Networks PYQs done. Mock 5 score > 50%. Only CO&A remaining.

phases.title: Computer Organization & Architecture + General Aptitude + Full Revision + Mocks
phases.note: Final sprint. CO&A in week 12. Week 13 is pure revision + mocks. No new topics after Jan 20.

weekly_plan.subject: Computer Organization & Architecture + General Aptitude Sprint
topics: Number representation: 2's complement, BCD, IEEE 754 floating point
CPU: datapath, instruction cycle, hardwired vs microprogrammed control
Pipelining: stages, structural/data/control hazards, forwarding, stalling
Cache memory: direct mapped, set-associative, fully associative, replacement policies, write policies

daily_targets.Mon: Number representation (2's complement, BCD, IEEE 754) + ALU design + instruction formats + addressing modes – lecture from scratch + PYQs
daily_targets.Tue: CPU: datapath, instruction cycle, hardwired vs microprogrammed control unit – lecture + DPP
daily_targets.Wed: Pipelining: 5-stage pipeline, structural/data/control hazards, data forwarding, branch prediction, stalling – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Thu: Cache memory: direct mapped, set-associative, fully associative mapping + replacement policies (LRU, FIFO, Random) + write policies (write-through, write-back) – lecture + problems
daily_targets.Fri: Main memory organization, DRAM, address calculation + I/O: polling, interrupt-driven, DMA – lecture + PYQs
daily_targets.Sat: Full CO&A PYQ set (last 10 years, timed) + Aptitude: verbal ability + numerical ability + analytical reasoning PYQ blitz (last 5 years) + 30 min Aptitude
daily_targets.Sun: Mock test 6: FULL SYLLABUS including CO&A + Aptitude (full 3 hr, exam conditions) + analysis

weekly_plan.subject: Full Revision + Intensive Mocks + Exam
topics: Targeted weak area revision, formula sheets, full mocks, exam

daily_targets.Mon: Weakest 2 subjects from Mock 6 – deep drill (3 hrs each: re-study from basics + PYQs)
daily_targets.Tue: Mock test 7 (full syllabus + Aptitude, 3 hr, exact exam conditions – morning slot)
daily_targets.Wed: Mock 7 analysis + all wrong answers re-attempt + error log
daily_targets.Thu: Mock test 8 (full syllabus + Aptitude, 3 hr, exact exam conditions)
daily_targets.Fri: Mock 8 analysis + formula sheet revision: Engg Math + DL + DS + Algorithms + TOC + Compiler
daily_targets.Sat: Formula sheet revision: OS + DBMS + Networks + CO&A + Aptitude + 30 min Aptitude PYQ blitz

phases.phase_end_milestone: 8+ full mocks done. All 11 subjects covered from scratch. Formula sheets ready.
